title: Iron for the {place}
Nails and hinges
summary: The smith of {settlement} needs {count} × {item} to make the fittings of the {place}.
Without metal there are no hinges, nails or lanterns for the {place} in {settlement}. Bring {count} × {item}.
offer: Every door wants hinges and every beam wants nails, and my forge is empty. {count} × {item}, and I'll pay above market.
The {place} needs its ironwork and I've nothing to work. Bring {count} × {item}?
progress: The forge is cold without that metal.
Still waiting. I've been sharpening the same knife all week.
complete: Good metal. You'll hear my hammer from the road.
That'll do nicely. The {place} gets its doors tomorrow.
